toegepas.voor: Shaka het teruggetrek en hulle so diep in sy eie land in gelok.
toegepas.na: Shaka het teruggetrek, en so het hy hulle diep in sy eie land ingelok.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The separable verb 'inlok' is split awkwardly and 'so diep' reads as 'that deep'; this keeps the sense of 'thereby' and gets the AWS comma between two clauses.
toegepas.fout: 'in gelok' splits the circumposition verb that AWS writes as 'ingelok', and 'so diep' can be read as 'that deep' instead of 'thereby'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same actions in the same order; the proposal spells the verb correctly, makes 'so' mean 'thereby', and puts the required comma between two full clauses.

toegepas.na: jong mans het in ouderdomsregimente (amabutho) gedien
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Was in' is vague; 'gedien' is more precise and matches the glossary definition of amabutho.
toegepas.fout: 'was in ouderdomsregimente' names no task in a block about everyone's task, unlike its neighbours 'het die gewasse verbou' and 'het na die vee gekyk'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Het ... gedien' states the task precisely, matches the glossary, adds no fact and leaves the protected words intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma before 'en' in a list breaks the AWS rule; 'asook' keeps the outer list clearly separate from the inner one.
toegepas.fout: The comma before 'en' that closes the inner list goes against the AWS list rule, and without it the outer and inner lists run together.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Asook' cleanly separates the river from the three areas without changing what the map must show.

laat_vaar.voor: Met party het dit deur 'n ooreenkoms gebeur en met baie deur oorlog.
laat_vaar.na: Met party het hy 'n ooreenkoms gesluit, en baie het hy in oorlog oorwin.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The elliptic 'met party het dit ... gebeur' is wooden; two plain clauses say the same thing more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original is a little elliptic but clear, and the proposal moves the meaning from 'came about through war' to 'he defeated them in war' and loses that the agreement itself brought them under his authority.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Many people's lives takes the plural 'lewens'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The distributive singular 'baie mense se lewe' is natural Afrikaans, so 'lewens' is a lateral move driven by English.

laat_vaar.voor: Families het steeds in opstalle gewoon met 'n heining om die hutte.
laat_vaar.na: Families het steeds in opstalle met 'n heining om die hutte gewoon.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The verb belongs at the end of the clause; the phrase after it reads as an afterthought.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the phrase after the verb is natural Afrikaans here and easier for a Grade 5 reader than a long middle field, so the change is lateral.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Elkeen' is the natural form here; 'elk' alone sounds stiff.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Floating 'elk' ('was elk 'n ring hutte') is correct standard Afrikaans; 'elkeen' is only a different equally good form.

laat_vaar.voor: Soos by die vroeë boere het mense ook in Shaka se tyd
laat_vaar.na: Soos by die vroeë boere het mense in Shaka se tyd
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Soos by' already makes the comparison, so 'ook' is redundant.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Soos ... ook' is a normal Afrikaans correlative pair, so removing 'ook' is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: Wanneer 'n gemeenskap self oor sy eie sake besluit.
laat_vaar.na: Die reg van 'n gemeenskap om self oor sy eie sake te besluit.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A noun is better defined by a noun phrase than by a 'wanneer' clause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A 'wanneer' definition is acceptable in a school glossary, and the proposal changes the meaning by adding 'die reg', turning a state into a right.

na_skrywer.voor: Die mag en die reg om ander te sê wat om te doen.
na_skrywer.na: Die mag en die reg om vir ander te sê wat hulle moet doen.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Iemand sê wat om te doen' is an anglicism; Afrikaans says 'vir iemand sê wat hy moet doen'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'ander te se wat om te doen' copies English 'tell others what to do'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a real anglicism, but it is a glossary definition, so the rewording goes to the writer rather than being made here.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
